description: This Java class implements the CachesConfig interface for the Ditto Concierge service, managing cache-related configurations such as timeouts and cache configurations for IDs and enforcers.

classes.name: DefaultCachesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that provides cache configurations such as timeouts and cache configs for IDs and enforcers, based on provided configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate DefaultCachesConfig from a Config object, with fallback handling.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout duration for ask operations.

methods.name: getIdCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for IDs.

methods.name: getEnforcerCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for enforcers.
